home.heroEyebrow: Leading OEM Manufacturer for the Top World Brands
home.heroTitle: Engineered Carbon Fiber. Built for Champions.
home.heroDesc: From ocean to sky — high-performance CFRP components that turn engineering ambition into competitive advantage.
home.applicationsDesc: Our high-performance carbon fiber products are at the forefront of innovation, providing lightweight and high-strength solutions for the world's most demanding industries.

sports.title: Sports
sports.desc: High-Performance Carbon Fiber Components for Sports Applications. We provide lightweight, durable, and precision-engineered carbon fiber components for water sports and other high-performance athletic equipment.

medical.title: Medical
medical.desc: Radiolucent and Lightweight Carbon Fiber Components for Medical Applications. Biocompatible materials, precision engineering, and reliable performance to meet medical industry standards.

uav.title: UAV / Drones
uav.desc: Lightweight and High-Strength Carbon Fiber Components for UAV Platforms. Optimized for weight, strength, and flight stability across frame structures and propeller supports.

industrial.title: Industrial / Custom
industrial.desc: Custom Carbon Fiber Components for Industrial Applications. Tailored high-strength, lightweight, and corrosion-resistant solutions for automation, robotics, and mechanical assemblies.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Crafting Carbon Fiber Excellence Since 2010
about.intro: HAPPYCOMPOSITE is a leading OEM manufacturer of high-performance carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) components, headquartered in Dongguan, China. With more than a decade of dedicated engineering and over 8,000㎡ of advanced manufacturing capacity, we serve global Tier-1 brands across sports, medical, UAV, and industrial markets.
about.missionText: To deliver the world's most reliable carbon fiber components through precision engineering, rigorous quality, and relentless innovation.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted CFRP partner for the brands that shape tomorrow's performance.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: End-to-end CFRP Manufacturing
capabilities.intro: From raw material selection to precision machining and surface finishing, every step is performed in-house under strict quality control.

sections.title: Sections
sections.subtitle: Standard & Custom Profiles
sections.intro: A growing library of standard sections — round tubes, square tubes, complex aerodynamic profiles, and fully custom geometries. All sections can be tailored in fiber orientation, layup, and surface finish.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.subtitle: Better Materials, Better Tomorrow
sustainability.intro: We are committed to reducing our environmental footprint through material efficiency, waste reduction, and continuous improvement across the production lifecycle.

material.title: Material Efficiency
material.desc: Optimized layup schedules minimize scrap while preserving structural performance.

energy.title: Energy & Emissions
energy.desc: Energy-conscious process design with continuous monitoring of consumption and emissions.

waste.title: Waste Reduction
waste.desc: Closed-loop material handling, offcut recycling, and responsible disposal of process chemicals.

people.title: People & Safety
people.desc: Strict occupational health and safety standards across every facility and shift.

contact.intro: Whether you are evaluating a new design or scaling an existing program, our engineering team is ready to help.
